experiment.length_definition: post-insertion passage tokens before task/chat template

prompt.direct_and_native_task_block:
The passage contains one or more city-score audit records. A city-score
audit record names one city and gives that city's numeric score.

How many city-score audit records are in the passage?
In the final answer, output exactly one line in this form:
Total: <integer>
prompt.enumeration_task_block:
The passage contains one or more city-score audit records. A city-score
audit record names one city and gives that city's numeric score.

Find every city-score audit record in the passage. In passage order, output
one record per line as:
<k>. <city>: <score>
where k starts at 1 and increases by 1.
Then output one final line:
Total: <integer>
Do not include any other text.

estimands.primary_exact: all requests; parse/format/truncation failures retained as zero
estimands.signed_bias: predicted_count - N, conditional on parsed numeric output

fixed_law.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within each target across 9 strata

candidate_grid.name: log_burden
candidate_grid.label: Log burden
candidate_grid.interpretation: Depends on the product of relative length and needle count.

candidate_grid.name: log_separable
candidate_grid.label: Separate log T + log N
candidate_grid.interpretation: Power-order terms for T and N with no interaction.

candidate_grid.name: semi_log_needles
candidate_grid.label: Log T + linear N
candidate_grid.interpretation: Power in T and exponential-in-N odds or transformed error.

candidate_grid.name: piecewise_log_needles
candidate_grid.label: Log T + piecewise log N
candidate_grid.interpretation: Allows the N slope to change above N=5.

candidate_grid.name: log_interaction
candidate_grid.label: Log T × log N
candidate_grid.interpretation: Allows the apparent order in one variable to depend on the other.

mode_specific_candidate_grid.name: log_needles_only
mode_specific_candidate_grid.label: Log N only
mode_specific_candidate_grid.interpretation: A single power/exponent term in needle count.

mode_specific_candidate_grid.name: linear_needles_only
mode_specific_candidate_grid.label: Linear N only
mode_specific_candidate_grid.interpretation: An exponential-in-N accuracy odds or linear transformed error.

mode_specific_candidate_grid.name: log_length_only
mode_specific_candidate_grid.label: Log T only
mode_specific_candidate_grid.interpretation: A single power/exponent term in passage length.

mode_specific_candidate_grid.name: semi_log_needles
mode_specific_candidate_grid.label: Log T + linear N
mode_specific_candidate_grid.interpretation: Power in T with exponential-in-N response.

mode_specific_candidate_grid.name: piecewise_log_needles
mode_specific_candidate_grid.label: Log T + piecewise log N
mode_specific_candidate_grid.interpretation: Allows the N slope to change above N=5.

mode_specific_candidate_grid.name: log_interaction
mode_specific_candidate_grid.label: Log T x log N
mode_specific_candidate_grid.interpretation: Lets the apparent N order depend on T.

mode_specific_candidate_grid.name: quadratic_surface
mode_specific_candidate_grid.label: Quadratic log surface
mode_specific_candidate_grid.interpretation: A smooth second-order surface in log T and log N.

mode_specific_candidate_grid.name: length_factor_log_n
mode_specific_candidate_grid.label: T-level intercepts + log N
mode_specific_candidate_grid.interpretation: Allows each observed T level its own intercept.

mode_specific_candidate_grid.name: length_factor_curved_n
mode_specific_candidate_grid.label: T-level intercepts + curved log N
mode_specific_candidate_grid.interpretation: Observed T-level intercepts plus smooth N curvature.

mode_specific_candidate_grid.name: length_specific_log_n
mode_specific_candidate_grid.label: T-specific log-N slopes
mode_specific_candidate_grid.interpretation: A separate log-N slope at each observed T level.

mode_specific_candidate_grid.name: length_specific_piecewise_n
mode_specific_candidate_grid.label: T-specific piecewise N
mode_specific_candidate_grid.interpretation: T-specific N slopes plus a shared high-N hinge.
